Overview
Junior Software Developer
Hybrid, onsite in Vienna, VA and Chantilly, VA with up to 3 days remote.
TS/SCI with Poly
 

At Bcore, our strength comes from how we deliver impact to the mission. Whether it’s architecting critical IT solutions, producing actionable intelligence, or developing cutting edge technology, we succeed because of the expertise, collaboration, and agility of our teams. Our Mission Services division combines enterprise IT, cloud solutions, DevSecOps, systems engineering, software development, and operational support. Bcore accelerates decisive advantage for warfighters and intelligence professionals by fusing human insight, rapid-fire engineering, precision-measured outcomes, and relentless grit into mission-ready solutions. 

 

Do you want to join a team that is building tailored technical solutions to modernize our government’s mission and our client’s business?  Do you have a desire to change how people work?  Are you interested in helping to protect our nation’s cyber interests? Join our growing team supporting customer missions as a Junior Software Developer in Hybrid, onsite in Vienna, VA and Chantilly, VA with up to 3 days remote.

Responsibilities
Learn to translate business problems into software solutions under the guidance of senior developers
Write code solutions that adhere to customer security and requirements
Supporting the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of software systems in collaboration with a multi-disciplinary team
Ensure compliance with software design, development, testing, integration, and sustainment standards
Research technology solutions and assist in resolving issues based on customer and business requirements
Ensure that products are designed and developed for scalability, robustness, maintainability, and interoperability
• Learn and apply Development Best Practices through mentorship and training
• Collaborate with team members and seek ways to grow technical skills
• Participate actively in code reviews and team learning activities
Qualifications

Required Qualifications:   

0-2+ years of experience with full-stack software development leveraging one or more programming languages (e.g. Python, Groovy, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Java, Node)
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (additional experience may be substituted for education)
Strong understanding of database foundations (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, etc.) to include:
o Basic understanding of relational database design principles (e.g. Normalization vs Denormalization)
o General knowledge of database administration concepts (e.g. users, schemas, constraints)
Possesses a basic understanding or has some experience working with multimedia streaming technologies and video processing workflows (encoding, transcoding, clipping)
Possesses a basic understanding or has some experience with API design and implementation
Experience working in a fast-paced agile environment

Desired Qualifications:

Possesses a basic understanding or has some experience working with Content Management Systems such as CrafterCMS
Preferred candidates present an understanding and some experience working with a
Model-View-Controller (MVC) architectural design pattern:
o Experience working with Java for backend development is ideal
o Experience working with JavaScript and TypeScript for frontend development is deal
Experience with Cloud Providers, preferably AWS
What you can expect from us
The expected salary range within the Washington, DC metropolitan area is: $135,000 - 165,000. Final compensation is unique to each individual and will be determined based on factors such as experience, education, geographic location, and contractual requirements. This is not a guarantee.
Benefits include Health/Dental/Vision, 401(k), Paid Time Off, STD/LTD/Life Insurance/Voluntary Life Insurance, Stipends, Referral Bonuses, and more.

BCore is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by law.
